Risk: Coordination failure among AI alignment researchers
Problem analysis: Fragmented discussion platforms hindering shared assumptions among alignment researchers
Theoretical insight: Centralised online forum can facilitate rapid peer review and coordination
Design rationale: Create controlled-access research forum linked to public platform for layered discussion
Implementation mechanism: Automatic crossposting system linking AI Alignment Forum and LessWrong
Validation evidence: Beta survey responses indicating expected increase in contributions (mean 3.7/6)
Intervention: Deploy automatic crossposting infrastructure between Forum and LessWrong
Source: https://www.alignmentforum.org/posts/FoiiRDC3EhjHx7ayY/introducing-the-ai-alignment-forum-faq
